mapper.select: SELECT d.doumail_id, d.chat_msg, d.chat_time, d.`read`, CASE WHEN d.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN d.to_user_id ELSE d.from_user_id END AS other_user_id, CASE WHEN d.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN u_to.nickname ELSE u_from.nickname END AS other_nick, CASE WHEN d.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN u_to.portrait ELSE u_from.portrait END AS other_portrait FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user u_from ON d.from_user_id = u_from.user_id LEFT JOIN user u_to ON d.to_user_id = u_to.user_id WHERE (d.from_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 1) OR (d.to_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 2) GROUP BY other_user_id ORDER BY d.chat_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END) AS conversation_count FROM doumail WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 1) OR (to_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2)

SELECT d.doumail_id, d.from_user_id, d.to_user_id, d.chat_msg, d.chat_time, d.`read`, u_from.nickname AS from_nick, u_from.portrait AS from_portrait FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user u_from ON d.from_user_id = u_from.user_id WHERE ((d.from_user_id = #{userId} AND d.to_user_id = #{targetUserId}) OR (d.from_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND d.to_user_id = #{userId})) AND ((d.from_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 1) OR (d.to_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 2)) ORDER BY d.chat_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doumail WHERE ((from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{targetUserId}) OR (from_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND to_user_id = #{userId})) AND ((from_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 1) OR (to_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2))
